description: Revert to the aggressive Matrix LR (0.11) and Embedding LR (1.4) with Depth 10 and WARMUP_RATIO=0.05, as historical data shows this configuration converges faster to a lower loss floor (~0.983) within the 5-minute budget compared to the conservative 0.06 LR (0.9791) which likely under-utilized the time, while maintaining the stable warmup to prevent early divergence.
